import math

int number(string text)
    return int(text)

int cents(string text)
    pieces := text.split(".")
    return 100 * number(pieces[0]) + number(pieces[1])

string money(int amount)
    absolute := math.abs(amount)
    return (if amount < 0 then "-" else "") + "{absolute / 100}.{absolute % 100:02.}"

string signed_money(int amount)
    return (if amount > 0 then "+" else "") + money(amount)

string percentage(int basis_points)
    return money(basis_points) + "%"

int period_length(string cycle)
    return if cycle == "WEEKLY" then 7 elif cycle == "MONTHLY" then 30 else 360

class Tier(int upper, int unit_price, int flat_fee)
class Plan(string name, int price, string cycle, int trial, int setup, bool per_seat, string mode, Tier[] tiers)
class Tax(string region, int rate)
class Customer(string name, string region, string method, int balance)
class Coupon(string name, string kind, int value, int applications, int maximum, int redemptions)
class Subscription(int customer, int plan, int seats, string status, int start, int end, int trial_end, int pause_start, int pending_plan, int pending_seats, bool cancel_end, int cancel_on, int canceled_on, int coupon, int remaining, int usage)
class Item(string description, int amount)
class Invoice(int sub, int customer, int day, string kind, Item[] items, int[] totals, int paid, int refunded, int outstanding, int attempts, int[] retries)
class BalanceRow(int day, int customer, string description, int change, int balance)
class Event(int day, int sub, string before, string after)
class State()
    day := 1
    Plan[] plans := []
    Tax[] taxes := []
    Customer[] customers := []
    Coupon[] coupons := []
    Subscription[] subscriptions := []
    Invoice[] invoices := []
    BalanceRow[] balances := []
    Event[] events := []

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void fail(string reason)
    emit("ERROR " + reason)

void notice(const State state, string text)
    emit("  day " + string(state.day) + " " + text)

int plan_id(const State state, string name)
    for: 0 <= i < int(#state.plans)
        if state.plans[i].name == name
            return i
    return -1

int customer_id(const State state, string name)
    for: 0 <= i < int(#state.customers)
        if state.customers[i].name == name
            return i
    return -1

int coupon_id(const State state, string name)
    for: 0 <= i < int(#state.coupons)
        if state.coupons[i].name == name
            return i
    return -1

int tax_rate(const State state, string region)
    for item := state.taxes[]
        if item.region == region
            return item.rate
    return 0

int plan_fee(const Plan plan, int seats)
    return plan.price * (if plan.per_seat then seats else 1)

int usage_charge(const Plan plan, int units)
    result := 0
    lower := 0
    for: 0 <= k < int(#plan.tiers)
        tier := plan.tiers[k]
        last := k + 1 == int(#plan.tiers)
        if plan.mode == "VOLUME"
            if last or tier.upper < 0 or units <= tier.upper
                return units * tier.unit_price + tier.flat_fee
        else
            if units <= lower
                break
            upper := if last or tier.upper < 0 then units else math.min(units, tier.upper)
            result += (upper - lower) * tier.unit_price + tier.flat_fee
            if last or tier.upper < 0
                break
            lower = tier.upper
    return result

string period_text(const Subscription sub)
    return string(sub.start) + "-" + string(sub.end)

void balance_change(State &state, int customer, int amount, string description)
    if amount == 0
        return
    state.customers[customer].balance += amount
    state.balances = state.balances.append(BalanceRow(state.day, customer, description, amount, state.customers[customer].balance))

void change_state(State &state, int sub, string next)
    before := state.subscriptions[sub].status
    if before == "PAST_DUE"
        for: 0 <= k < int(#state.invoices)
            if state.invoices[k].sub == sub
                state.invoices[k].retries = []
    state.subscriptions[sub].status = next
    notice(state, "sub " + string(sub + 1) + " " + before + " -> " + next)
    state.events = state.events.append(Event(state.day, sub, before, next))

Item period_item(const Plan plan, int seats, int start)
    return Item("charge " + plan.name + " seats " + string(seats) + " " + string(start) + "-" + string(start + period_length(plan.cycle)), plan_fee(plan, seats))

Item[] opening_items(const State state, int sub, int start)
    subscription := state.subscriptions[sub]
    plan := state.plans[subscription.plan]
    items := [period_item(plan, subscription.seats, start)]
    if plan.setup > 0
        items = items.append(Item("setup " + plan.name, plan.setup))
    return items

Item[] usage_items(const State state, int sub)
    subscription := state.subscriptions[sub]
    plan := state.plans[subscription.plan]
    if plan.mode == "" or subscription.usage == 0
        return []
    return [Item("usage " + plan.name + " " + string(subscription.usage) + " units", usage_charge(plan, subscription.usage))]

Item[] close_usage(State &state, int sub)
    items := usage_items(state, sub)
    if #items > 0
        state.subscriptions[sub].usage = 0
    return items

bool coupon_usable(const Subscription subscription, int subtotal)
    return subtotal > 0 and subscription.coupon >= 0 and subscription.remaining != 0

int[] invoice_totals(const State state, int sub, const Item[] items)
    subtotal := 0
    for item := items[]
        subtotal += item.amount
    subscription := state.subscriptions[sub]
    discount := 0
    if coupon_usable(subscription, subtotal)
        coupon := state.coupons[subscription.coupon]
        discount = if coupon.kind == "PERCENT" then subtotal * coupon.value / 10000 else math.min(subtotal, coupon.value)
    customer := state.customers[subscription.customer]
    tax := (subtotal - discount) * tax_rate(state, customer.region) / 10000
    total := subtotal - discount + tax
    credit := math.min(customer.balance, total)
    return [subtotal, discount, tax, total, credit, total - credit]

void issue(State &state, int sub, string kind, const Item[] items)
    totals := invoice_totals(state, sub, items)
    index := int(#state.invoices)
    subscription := state.subscriptions[sub]
    if coupon_usable(subscription, totals[0]) and subscription.remaining > 0
        state.subscriptions[sub].remaining -= 1
    state.invoices = state.invoices.append(Invoice(sub, subscription.customer, state.day, kind, items, totals, 0, 0, totals[5], 0, []))
    balance_change(&state, subscription.customer, -totals[4], "applied invoice " + string(index + 1))
    result := "PAID"
    if totals[5] > 0
        if subscription.status == "UNPAID"
            result = "OPEN"
        else
            state.invoices[index].attempts = 1
            if state.customers[subscription.customer].method == "OK"
                state.invoices[index].paid = totals[5]
                state.invoices[index].outstanding = 0
            else
                result = "FAILED"
    notice(state, "invoice " + string(index + 1) + " sub " + string(sub + 1) + " " + kind + " total " + money(totals[3]) + " credit " + money(totals[4]) + " due " + money(totals[5]) + " " + result)
    if result == "FAILED"
        if state.subscriptions[sub].status == "ACTIVE"
            change_state(&state, sub, "PAST_DUE")
        if state.subscriptions[sub].status == "PAST_DUE"
            state.invoices[index].retries = [state.day + 3, state.day + 5, state.day + 7]

void payment_complete(State &state, int invoice)
    state.invoices[invoice].retries = []
    sub := state.invoices[invoice].sub
    status := state.subscriptions[sub].status
    if status != "PAST_DUE" and status != "UNPAID"
        return
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.invoices)
        if state.invoices[k].sub == sub and state.invoices[k].outstanding > 0
            return
    state.subscriptions[sub].cancel_on = -1
    change_state(&state, sub, "ACTIVE")

void cancel_subscription(State &state, int sub)
    change_state(&state, sub, "CANCELED")
    state.subscriptions[sub].canceled_on = state.day
    state.subscriptions[sub].pending_plan = -1
    state.subscriptions[sub].cancel_end = false
    state.subscriptions[sub].cancel_on = -1
    items := close_usage(&state, sub)
    if #items > 0
        issue(&state, sub, "final", items)

void retry(State &state, int invoice)
    bill := state.invoices[invoice]
    state.invoices[invoice].retries = if #bill.retries <= 1 then [] else bill.retries[1:]
    state.invoices[invoice].attempts += 1
    attempt := state.invoices[invoice].attempts - 1
    if state.customers[bill.customer].method == "OK"
        state.invoices[invoice].paid += state.invoices[invoice].outstanding
        state.invoices[invoice].outstanding = 0
        notice(state, "retry " + string(attempt) + " invoice " + string(invoice + 1) + " PAID")
        payment_complete(&state, invoice)
    else
        notice(state, "retry " + string(attempt) + " invoice " + string(invoice + 1) + " FAILED")
        if #state.invoices[invoice].retries == 0
            change_state(&state, bill.sub, "UNPAID")
            state.subscriptions[bill.sub].cancel_on = state.day + 14

void advance_subscription(State &state, int sub)
    status := state.subscriptions[sub].status
    if status == "PAUSED" or status == "CANCELED"
        return
    existing := int(#state.invoices)
    for: 0 <= i < existing
        if state.invoices[i].sub == sub and #state.invoices[i].retries > 0
            if state.invoices[i].retries[0] == state.day
                retry(&state, i)
    if state.subscriptions[sub].status == "UNPAID" and state.subscriptions[sub].cancel_on == state.day
        cancel_subscription(&state, sub)
    if state.subscriptions[sub].status == "TRIALING" and state.subscriptions[sub].trial_end == state.day
        if state.subscriptions[sub].cancel_end
            cancel_subscription(&state, sub)
        else
            change_state(&state, sub, "ACTIVE")
            state.subscriptions[sub].start = state.day
            state.subscriptions[sub].end = state.day + period_length(state.plans[state.subscriptions[sub].plan].cycle)
            issue(&state, sub, "first", opening_items(state, sub, state.day))
    status = state.subscriptions[sub].status
    if (status == "ACTIVE" or status == "PAST_DUE" or status == "UNPAID") and state.subscriptions[sub].end == state.day
        if state.subscriptions[sub].cancel_end
            cancel_subscription(&state, sub)
        else
            items := close_usage(&state, sub)
            pending := state.subscriptions[sub].pending_plan
            if pending >= 0
                old := state.subscriptions[sub]
                notice(state, "sub " + string(sub + 1) + " " + state.plans[old.plan].name + " seats " + string(old.seats) + " -> " + state.plans[pending].name + " seats " + string(old.pending_seats))
                state.subscriptions[sub].plan = pending
                state.subscriptions[sub].seats = old.pending_seats
                state.subscriptions[sub].pending_plan = -1
            plan := state.plans[state.subscriptions[sub].plan]
            state.subscriptions[sub].start = state.day
            state.subscriptions[sub].end = state.day + period_length(plan.cycle)
            items = items.append(period_item(plan, state.subscriptions[sub].seats, state.day))
            issue(&state, sub, "renewal", items)

void emit_items(const Item[] items)
    for item := items[]
        emit("  " + item.description + " " + money(item.amount))

void emit_totals(int[] totals)
    emit("  subtotal " + money(totals[0]) + " discount " + money(totals[1]) + " tax " + money(totals[2]) + " total " + money(totals[3]))

void command(State &state, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    action := words[0]
    if action == "PLAN"
        if plan_id(state, words[1]) >= 0
            fail("duplicate plan " + words[1])
            return
        price := cents(words[2])
        cycle := words[3]
        trial := 0
        setup := 0
        per_seat := false
        mode := ""
        i := 4
        while i < int(#words)
            if words[i] == "TRIAL"
                trial = number(words[i + 1])
                i += 2
            elif words[i] == "SETUP"
                setup = cents(words[i + 1])
                i += 2
            elif words[i] == "PERSEAT"
                per_seat = true
                i += 1
            else
                mode = words[i]
                i += 1
        state.plans = state.plans.append(Plan(words[1], price, cycle, trial, setup, per_seat, mode, []))
        emit("PLAN " + words[1] + " " + cycle + " " + money(price) + (if trial > 0 then " trial " + string(trial) else "") + (if setup > 0 then " setup " + money(setup) else "") + (if per_seat then " perseat" else "") + (if mode == "" then "" elif mode == "GRADUATED" then " graduated" else " volume"))
        return
    if action == "TIER"
        plan := plan_id(state, words[1])
        if plan < 0
            fail("unknown plan " + words[1])
            return
        if state.plans[plan].mode == ""
            fail("not metered " + words[1])
            return
        upper := if words[2] == "INF" then -1 else number(words[2])
        tiers := state.plans[plan].tiers
        if #tiers > 0
            previous := tiers[-1].upper
            if previous < 0 or (upper >= 0 and upper <= previous)
                fail("tier order " + words[1])
                return
        state.plans[plan].tiers = tiers.append(Tier(upper, cents(words[3]), cents(words[4])))
        emit("TIER " + words[1] + " " + string(#state.plans[plan].tiers) + " upto " + words[2] + " unit " + words[3] + " flat " + words[4])
        return
    if action == "TAX"
        found := false
        for: 0 <= i < int(#state.taxes)
            if state.taxes[i].region == words[1]
                state.taxes[i].rate = number(words[2])
                found = true
        if not found
            state.taxes = state.taxes.append(Tax(words[1], number(words[2])))
        emit("TAX " + words[1] + " " + percentage(number(words[2])))
        return
    if action == "CUSTOMER"
        if customer_id(state, words[1]) >= 0
            fail("duplicate customer " + words[1])
        else
            state.customers = state.customers.append(Customer(words[1], words[2], "OK", 0))
            emit("CUSTOMER " + words[1] + " region " + words[2])
        return
    if action == "COUPON"
        if coupon_id(state, words[1]) >= 0
            fail("duplicate coupon " + words[1])
            return
        kind := words[2]
        value := if kind == "PERCENT" then number(words[3]) else cents(words[3])
        applications := if words[4] == "ONCE" then 1 else -1
        offset := 5
        if words[4] == "REPEATING"
            applications = number(words[5])
            offset = 6
        maximum := if offset < int(#words) then number(words[offset + 1]) else -1
        state.coupons = state.coupons.append(Coupon(words[1], kind, value, applications, maximum, 0))
        emit("COUPON " + words[1] + " " + (if kind == "PERCENT" then "percent " + percentage(value) else "amount " + money(value)) + " " + (if words[4] == "ONCE" then "once" elif words[4] == "FOREVER" then "forever" else "repeating " + string(applications)) + (if maximum >= 0 then " max " + string(maximum) else ""))
        return
    if action == "DAY"
        target := number(words[1])
        if target <= state.day
            fail("invalid day " + words[1])
            return
        emit("DAY " + string(target))
        while state.day < target
            state.day += 1
            for: 0 <= sub < int(#state.subscriptions)
                advance_subscription(&state, sub)
        return
    if action == "MRR"
        emit("MRR")
        names := [for plan := state.plans[] then plan.name]
        names = names.sorted()
        total_subs := 0
        total_mrr := 0
        for name := names[]
            plan := plan_id(state, name)
            entry := state.plans[plan]
            count := 0
            amount := 0
            for sub := state.subscriptions[]
                if sub.plan == plan and (sub.status == "ACTIVE" or sub.status == "PAST_DUE")
                    fee := plan_fee(entry, sub.seats)
                    amount += if entry.cycle == "MONTHLY" then fee elif entry.cycle == "YEARLY" then fee / 12 else fee * 30 / 7
                    count += 1
            if count > 0
                emit("  " + name + " subs " + string(count) + " mrr " + money(amount))
                total_subs += count
                total_mrr += amount
        emit("  total subs " + string(total_subs) + " mrr " + money(total_mrr))
        return
    if action == "AGING"
        emit("AGING day " + string(state.day))
        names := [for customer := state.customers[] then customer.name]
        names = names.sorted()
        totals := array(3, fill = 0)
        for name := names[]
            customer := customer_id(state, name)
            amounts := array(3, fill = 0)
            for invoice := state.invoices[]
                if invoice.customer == customer and invoice.outstanding > 0
                    age := state.day - invoice.day
                    bucket := if age <= 30 then 0 elif age <= 60 then 1 else 2
                    amounts[bucket] += invoice.outstanding
            if amounts.sum() > 0
                emit("  " + name + " 0-30 " + money(amounts[0]) + " 31-60 " + money(amounts[1]) + " 61+ " + money(amounts[2]) + " sum " + money(amounts.sum()))
                for: 0 <= k < 3
                    totals[k] += amounts[k]
        emit("  total 0-30 " + money(totals[0]) + " 31-60 " + money(totals[1]) + " 61+ " + money(totals[2]) + " sum " + money(totals.sum()))
        return
    if action == "DUNNING"
        emit("DUNNING")
        found := false
        for: 0 <= k < int(#state.invoices)
            invoice := state.invoices[k]
            if #invoice.retries > 0
                found = true
                emit("  invoice " + string(k + 1) + " sub " + string(invoice.sub + 1) + " " + state.customers[invoice.customer].name + " outstanding " + money(invoice.outstanding) + " attempts " + string(invoice.attempts) + " next " + string(invoice.retries[0]))
        if not found
            emit("  (none)")
        return
    if action == "REVENUE"
        sums := array(6, fill = 0)
        paid := 0
        refunded := 0
        outstanding := 0
        balances := 0
        for invoice := state.invoices[]
            for: 0 <= k < 6
                sums[k] += invoice.totals[k]
            paid += invoice.paid
            refunded += invoice.refunded
            outstanding += invoice.outstanding
        for customer := state.customers[]
            balances += customer.balance
        emit("REVENUE")
        emit("  invoices " + string(#state.invoices) + " subtotal " + money(sums[0]) + " discount " + money(sums[1]) + " tax " + money(sums[2]) + " total " + money(sums[3]))
        emit("  credit " + money(sums[4]) + " paid " + money(paid) + " refunded " + money(refunded) + " outstanding " + money(outstanding) + " balances " + money(balances))
        return
    if action == "EVENTS"
        selected := -1
        if #words > 1
            selected = number(words[1]) - 1
            if selected < 0 or selected >= int(#state.subscriptions)
                fail("unknown sub " + words[1])
                return
        emit("EVENTS" + (if selected >= 0 then " sub " + string(selected + 1) else ""))
        found := false
        for event := state.events[]
            if selected < 0 or event.sub == selected
                emit("  day " + string(event.day) + " sub " + string(event.sub + 1) + " " + event.before + " -> " + event.after)
                found = true
        if not found
            emit("  (none)")
        return
    if action == "PAYMETHOD" or action == "CREDIT" or action == "STATEMENT" or action == "LEDGER"
        customer := customer_id(state, words[1])
        if customer < 0
            fail("unknown customer " + words[1])
            return
        if action == "PAYMETHOD"
            state.customers[customer].method = words[2]
            emit("PAYMETHOD " + words[1] + " " + words[2])
        elif action == "CREDIT"
            amount := cents(words[2])
            if amount == 0
                fail("invalid amount")
            else
                balance_change(&state, customer, amount, "grant")
                emit("CREDIT " + words[1] + " amount " + money(amount) + " balance " + money(state.customers[customer].balance))
        elif action == "STATEMENT"
            item := state.customers[customer]
            emit("STATEMENT " + item.name + " region " + item.region + " tax " + percentage(tax_rate(state, item.region)) + " method " + item.method + " balance " + money(item.balance))
            for: 0 <= k < int(#state.subscriptions)
                sub := state.subscriptions[k]
                if sub.customer == customer
                    emit("  sub " + string(k + 1) + " " + state.plans[sub.plan].name + " " + sub.status)
            total := 0
            for: 0 <= k < int(#state.invoices)
                invoice := state.invoices[k]
                if invoice.customer == customer
                    emit("  invoice " + string(k + 1) + " day " + string(invoice.day) + " sub " + string(invoice.sub + 1) + " " + invoice.kind + " total " + money(invoice.totals[3]) + " outstanding " + money(invoice.outstanding))
                    total += invoice.outstanding
            emit("  outstanding " + money(total))
        else
            emit("LEDGER " + words[1] + " balance " + money(state.customers[customer].balance))
            found := false
            for row := state.balances[]
                if row.customer == customer
                    emit("  day " + string(row.day) + " " + row.description + " " + signed_money(row.change) + " balance " + money(row.balance))
                    found = true
            if not found
                emit("  (none)")
        return
    if action == "SUBSCRIBE"
        customer := customer_id(state, words[1])
        if customer < 0
            fail("unknown customer " + words[1])
            return
        plan := plan_id(state, words[2])
        if plan < 0
            fail("unknown plan " + words[2])
            return
        seats := 1
        has_seats := false
        coupon := -1
        coupon_name := ""
        for: 3 <= k < int(#words) step 2
            if words[k] == "SEATS"
                has_seats = true
                seats = number(words[k + 1])
            else
                coupon_name = words[k + 1]
        if has_seats and not state.plans[plan].per_seat
            fail("not per-seat " + words[2])
            return
        if seats == 0
            fail("invalid seats")
            return
        if coupon_name != ""
            coupon = coupon_id(state, coupon_name)
            if coupon < 0
                fail("unknown coupon " + coupon_name)
                return
            item := state.coupons[coupon]
            if item.maximum >= 0 and item.redemptions == item.maximum
                fail("coupon exhausted " + coupon_name)
                return
        sub := int(#state.subscriptions)
        remaining := -1
        if coupon >= 0
            remaining = state.coupons[coupon].applications
            state.coupons[coupon].redemptions += 1
        state.subscriptions = state.subscriptions.append(Subscription(customer, plan, seats, "NONE", -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, 0, false, -1, -1, coupon, remaining, 0))
        emit("SUBSCRIBE sub " + string(sub + 1) + " " + words[1] + " " + words[2] + " seats " + string(seats) + (if coupon >= 0 then " coupon " + coupon_name else ""))
        if state.plans[plan].trial > 0
            state.subscriptions[sub].trial_end = state.day + state.plans[plan].trial
            change_state(&state, sub, "TRIALING")
        else
            change_state(&state, sub, "ACTIVE")
            state.subscriptions[sub].start = state.day
            state.subscriptions[sub].end = state.day + period_length(state.plans[plan].cycle)
            issue(&state, sub, "first", opening_items(state, sub, state.day))
        return
    if action == "INVOICE" or action == "PAY" or action == "REFUND"
        invoice := number(words[1]) - 1
        if invoice < 0 or invoice >= int(#state.invoices)
            fail("unknown invoice " + words[1])
            return
        if action == "INVOICE"
            bill := state.invoices[invoice]
            emit("INVOICE " + words[1] + " sub " + string(bill.sub + 1) + " " + state.customers[bill.customer].name + " day " + string(bill.day) + " " + bill.kind + " " + (if bill.outstanding == 0 then "PAID" else "OPEN"))
            emit_items(bill.items)
            emit_totals(bill.totals)
            emit("  credit " + money(bill.totals[4]) + " due " + money(bill.totals[5]) + " paid " + money(bill.paid) + " refunded " + money(bill.refunded) + " outstanding " + money(bill.outstanding))
        elif action == "PAY"
            if state.invoices[invoice].outstanding == 0
                fail("already paid " + words[1])
            else
                amount := state.invoices[invoice].outstanding
                emit("PAY invoice " + words[1] + " amount " + money(amount))
                state.invoices[invoice].paid += amount
                state.invoices[invoice].outstanding = 0
                payment_complete(&state, invoice)
        else
            amount := cents(words[2])
            bill := state.invoices[invoice]
            if amount == 0
                fail("invalid amount")
            elif amount > bill.totals[3] - bill.refunded
                fail("refund exceeds " + words[1] + " " + money(bill.totals[3] - bill.refunded))
            else
                applied := math.min(amount, bill.outstanding)
                state.invoices[invoice].refunded += amount
                state.invoices[invoice].outstanding -= applied
                balance_change(&state, bill.customer, amount - applied, "refund invoice " + words[1])
                emit("REFUND invoice " + words[1] + " amount " + money(amount) + " applied " + money(applied) + " balance " + money(state.customers[bill.customer].balance))
                if applied > 0 and state.invoices[invoice].outstanding == 0
                    payment_complete(&state, invoice)
        return
    sub := number(words[1]) - 1
    if sub < 0 or sub >= int(#state.subscriptions)
        fail("unknown sub " + words[1])
        return
    subscription := state.subscriptions[sub]
    if action == "SUB"
        emit("SUB " + words[1] + " " + state.customers[subscription.customer].name + " " + state.plans[subscription.plan].name + " seats " + string(subscription.seats) + " " + subscription.status)
        if subscription.status == "TRIALING"
            emit("  trial until " + string(subscription.trial_end))
        if subscription.status == "ACTIVE" or subscription.status == "PAST_DUE" or subscription.status == "UNPAID" or subscription.status == "PAUSED"
            emit("  period " + period_text(subscription))
        if subscription.status == "PAUSED"
            emit("  paused since " + string(subscription.pause_start))
        if subscription.pending_plan >= 0
            emit("  pending " + state.plans[subscription.pending_plan].name + " seats " + string(subscription.pending_seats))
        if subscription.cancel_end
            emit("  cancel at end")
        if subscription.cancel_on >= 0
            emit("  cancel on " + string(subscription.cancel_on))
        if subscription.status == "CANCELED"
            emit("  canceled on " + string(subscription.canceled_on))
        if subscription.coupon >= 0
            if subscription.remaining < 0
                emit("  coupon " + state.coupons[subscription.coupon].name + " forever")
            elif subscription.remaining > 0
                emit("  coupon " + state.coupons[subscription.coupon].name + " left " + string(subscription.remaining))
        if state.plans[subscription.plan].mode != "" and subscription.status != "CANCELED"
            emit("  usage " + string(subscription.usage))
        open := [for k := (0:<int(#state.invoices))[]
                      if state.invoices[k].sub == sub and state.invoices[k].outstanding > 0 then k + 1]
        if #open > 0
            emit("  open " + [for id := open[] then string(id)].join(" "))
        return
    if action == "PREVIEW"
        if subscription.status == "PAUSED" or subscription.status == "CANCELED"
            fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
            return
        due_day := if subscription.status == "TRIALING" then subscription.trial_end else subscription.end
        Item[] items := []
        kind := "renewal"
        if subscription.cancel_end
            kind = "final"
            if subscription.status != "TRIALING"
                items = usage_items(state, sub)
        elif subscription.status == "TRIALING"
            kind = "first"
            items = opening_items(state, sub, due_day)
        else
            items = usage_items(state, sub)
            plan := if subscription.pending_plan >= 0 then subscription.pending_plan else subscription.plan
            seats := if subscription.pending_plan >= 0 then subscription.pending_seats else subscription.seats
            items = items.append(period_item(state.plans[plan], seats, due_day))
        emit("PREVIEW sub " + words[1] + " day " + string(due_day) + " " + kind)
        if #items == 0
            emit("  (none)")
        else
            emit_items(items)
            totals := invoice_totals(state, sub, items)
            emit_totals(totals)
            emit("  credit " + money(totals[4]) + " due " + money(totals[5]))
        return
    if action == "APPLY"
        if subscription.status == "CANCELED"
            fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
            return
        coupon := coupon_id(state, words[2])
        if coupon < 0
            fail("unknown coupon " + words[2])
        elif state.coupons[coupon].maximum >= 0 and state.coupons[coupon].redemptions == state.coupons[coupon].maximum
            fail("coupon exhausted " + words[2])
        else
            state.coupons[coupon].redemptions += 1
            state.subscriptions[sub].coupon = coupon
            state.subscriptions[sub].remaining = state.coupons[coupon].applications
            emit("APPLY sub " + words[1] + " coupon " + words[2])
        return
    if action == "PAUSE"
        if subscription.status != "ACTIVE"
            fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
        else
            emit("PAUSE sub " + words[1])
            state.subscriptions[sub].pause_start = state.day
            change_state(&state, sub, "PAUSED")
        return
    if action == "RESUME"
        if subscription.status != "PAUSED"
            fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
        else
            elapsed := state.day - subscription.pause_start
            state.subscriptions[sub].end += elapsed
            state.subscriptions[sub].pause_start = -1
            emit("RESUME sub " + words[1] + " shift " + string(elapsed) + " period " + period_text(state.subscriptions[sub]))
            change_state(&state, sub, "ACTIVE")
        return
    if action == "CANCEL"
        if words[2] == "END"
            if subscription.status != "ACTIVE" and subscription.status != "TRIALING"
                fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
            elif subscription.cancel_end
                fail("already canceling " + words[1])
            else
                state.subscriptions[sub].cancel_end = true
                end := if subscription.status == "TRIALING" then subscription.trial_end else subscription.end
                emit("CANCEL sub " + words[1] + " end " + string(end))
        else
            if subscription.status == "CANCELED"
                fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
                return
            refund := 0
            if subscription.status == "ACTIVE" or subscription.status == "PAUSED"
                start := if subscription.status == "ACTIVE" then state.day else subscription.pause_start
                refund = plan_fee(state.plans[subscription.plan], subscription.seats) * (subscription.end - start) / period_length(state.plans[subscription.plan].cycle)
            balance_change(&state, subscription.customer, refund, "cancel sub " + words[1])
            emit("CANCEL sub " + words[1] + " now credit " + money(refund))
            cancel_subscription(&state, sub)
        return
    if action == "USAGE"
        if subscription.status != "ACTIVE" and subscription.status != "PAST_DUE"
            fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
            return
        if state.plans[subscription.plan].mode == ""
            fail("not metered " + state.plans[subscription.plan].name)
            return
        units := number(words[2])
        if units == 0
            fail("invalid units")
        else
            state.subscriptions[sub].usage += units
            emit("USAGE sub " + words[1] + " units " + string(units) + " total " + string(state.subscriptions[sub].usage))
        return
    if action == "CHANGE"
        if subscription.status != "ACTIVE" and subscription.status != "TRIALING"
            fail("invalid state " + words[1] + " " + subscription.status)
            return
        plan := subscription.plan
        seats := subscription.seats
        if words[2] == "PLAN"
            plan = plan_id(state, words[3])
            if plan < 0
                fail("unknown plan " + words[3])
                return
            if not state.plans[plan].per_seat
                seats = 1
        else
            if not state.plans[plan].per_seat
                fail("not per-seat " + state.plans[plan].name)
                return
            seats = number(words[3])
            if seats == 0
                fail("invalid seats")
                return
        if plan == subscription.plan and seats == subscription.seats
            fail("no change " + words[1])
            return
        old := state.plans[subscription.plan]
        next := state.plans[plan]
        heading := "CHANGE sub " + words[1] + " " + old.name + " seats " + string(subscription.seats) + " -> " + next.name + " seats " + string(seats)
        state.subscriptions[sub].pending_plan = -1
        old_fee := plan_fee(old, subscription.seats)
        next_fee := plan_fee(next, seats)
        upgrade := next_fee * period_length(old.cycle) > old_fee * period_length(next.cycle)
        if subscription.status == "TRIALING"
            state.subscriptions[sub].plan = plan
            state.subscriptions[sub].seats = seats
            emit(heading + " now")
        elif upgrade
            emit(heading + " now")
            days := subscription.end - state.day
            items := close_usage(&state, sub)
            items = items.append(Item("unused " + old.name + " seats " + string(subscription.seats) + " " + string(days) + " days", -(old_fee * days / period_length(old.cycle))))
            items = items.append(Item("remaining " + next.name + " seats " + string(seats) + " " + string(days) + " days", next_fee * days / period_length(next.cycle)))
            state.subscriptions[sub].plan = plan
            state.subscriptions[sub].seats = seats
            issue(&state, sub, "upgrade", items)
        else
            state.subscriptions[sub].pending_plan = plan
            state.subscriptions[sub].pending_seats = seats
            emit(heading + " at " + string(subscription.end))

command_count := 0
scan(&command_count)
billing := State()
for: 0 <= i < command_count
    line := ""
    scan(&line)
    command(&billing, line)
